{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the deduplication strategy: keep row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_sorted = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify that we now have one row per patient
assert len(df_dedup) == len(df_dedup['patient_id'].unique()), "Deduplication failed: still multiple rows per patient"

# Final count of unique patients
unique_patients_count = len(df_dedup)
unique_patients_count"}
